probes.description: An application module imports infrastructure directly, crossing a layer boundary.
probes.expectation: The architecture policy reports a forbidden layer dependency.

probes.description: One web feature imports another feature private module instead of its public entrypoint.
probes.expectation: The architecture policy reports a cross-feature private import.

probes.description: The published contract package gains a field that the transport and web clients do not know.
probes.expectation: Contract checks fail against the published schema.

probes.description: The transport accepts an actor identifier from the request body.
The domain imports the persistence framework.
probes.expectation: The architecture policy reports a domain framework dependency.

probes.description: The application service opens the database transaction instead of the infrastructure adapter.
A valid board identifier from another organization is accepted because the tenant check was dropped.
The optimistic version check is removed so concurrent updates overwrite each other.
The initial migration is no longer transactional.
The acceptance-bound unit test is deleted.
probes.expectation: The unit gate fails on a missing acceptance test.

probes.description: The recorded architecture evidence diverges from the approved contract.
The security script is removed from the manifest so the gate cannot run.
probes.expectation: The omitted gate stays blocked instead of passing.

probes.description: A workspace mutation lands outside the approved project authority.
probes.expectation: The authority check rejects the mutation and reports it.

probes.description: A delivery session state file diverges after an interrupted resume.
probes.expectation: Resume stops for reconciliation instead of trusting the drifted state.
